project_title: ApexTrade Pro - Paper Trading Terminal (Stocks, Crypto, ETFs)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade paper trading platform with interactive charts (candlestick & line), order book depth visualizer, real-time ticker tape, multi-asset search (Stocks, Crypto, ETFs), order execution forms (Market, Limit, Stop-Loss), portfolio analytics, transaction history, and adjustable $100,000 paper balance management.

Implement a dark high-density Pro Trader UI inspired by TradingView and Webull Pro Desktop. Use strict grid panels with 1px borders (#1E222D / #2A2E39), tabular numbers for pricing (`font-mono tabular-nums`), and explicit green/red market semantics.
All interactive and key data display elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="buy-order-button"`, `data-testid="portfolio-total-value"`, `data-testid="timeframe-1d-btn"`).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or modal overlays. Always use solid surfaces like `bg-[#131722]` or `bg-[#1E222D]` with crisp borders.
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for icons. Do NOT use emojis as UI icons.

font_families.numbers_and_prices: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, or monospace with `tabular-nums` class

scale.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-400
scale.price_large: font-mono text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight tabular-nums

visual_enhancers.ticker_tape: Top full-width streaming ticker tape showing live price feeds, % change with green/red status indicators, and quick click-to-trade shortcuts.
visual_enhancers.grid_layout: Bento density layout with 1px border dividers (`border-[#2A2E39]`), zero layout gaps or precise gap-2/gap-3 spacing.
visual_enhancers.order_book_depth: Visual order depth bars with opacity fill (`bg-[#089981]/15` for bids, `bg-[#F23645]/15` for asks) indicating cumulative order volume.
visual_enhancers.active_indicator: Active tab/timeframe indicator with glow outline or solid pill indicator in `#2962FF`.
visual_enhancers.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` (`/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`) for trade executions, price alerts, and cash balance updates.

login_signup.structure: Split screen. Left panel: Live interactive mini-chart ticker showing $100,000 paper trading simulation stats & features. Right panel: Solid `#131722` card with login/signup form, paper account setup ($100,000 default balance selector), and demo quick-login button (`data-testid="demo-login-btn"`).

dashboard.structure: Top Ticker Tape Header -> Navigation Bar -> 4-Column Grid Layout. (1) Portfolio Summary Card ($100,000 Cash, Invested Value, Daily P/L, Total ROI %, Reset Balance button). (2) Main Portfolio Equity Growth Line/Area Chart. (3) Active Asset Allocations Donut/Pie breakdown (Stocks vs Crypto vs ETFs). (4) Watchlist Panel with quick Search & Filter tabs. Bottom section: Active Positions Table with Real-time P/L and Close Position buttons.

trade_chart_page.structure: Header Info Bar (Symbol, Price, 24h High/Low/Vol) -> Main Workstation split: Left (65%): Interactive Recharts/Chart Canvas with Candlestick/Line view, timeframe selector (1D, 1W, 1M, 1Y, ALL), indicators overlay toggle. Middle (20%): Real-time Order Book & Recent Trades Stream. Right (15%): Buy/Sell Order Form (Market / Limit / Stop Order, Quantity, Leverage/Paper Cash calculator, Quick % buttons 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%).

markets_browser.structure: Top Stats Bar (Top Gainers, Top Losers, Most Active) -> Asset Category Tabs (All, Stocks, Crypto, ETFs) -> Search & Filter Bar -> High density Table with Symbol, Name, Price, 24h Change %, 24h Volume, Sparkline Chart column, and Direct Trade Action Button (`data-testid="trade-symbol-btn"`).

portfolio.structure: Top Portfolio Breakdown Header -> P/L Performance Analytics -> Asset Holdings Table (Asset, Allocation %, Avg Buy Price, Current Price, Un-realized P/L, Actions: Buy More / Sell) -> Cash Balance Management Modal (Deposit Paper Cash, Adjust Balance, Reset Portfolio).

orders_history.structure: Tabs (Open Orders, Filled Orders, Cancelled Orders, Trade History) -> Filter by Asset Type -> Table with Order ID, Timestamp, Symbol, Type (BUY/SELL), Order Class (Market/Limit), Executed Price, Amount, Total Value, Status Badge.

component_mapping.tables: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/table.jsx customized with dark background `#131722`, sticky header `#1E222D`, and mono price columns.
component_mapping.tabs: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/tabs.jsx with tight compact tab lists `h-8 bg-[#0B0E14] text-xs`.
component_mapping.dialogs: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx for cash balance deposit/reset and position closing confirmation.
component_mapping.select: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/select.jsx for order types and timeframe selectors.

chart_integration_guidance.library: Recharts / Custom Canvas or SVG chart
chart_integration_guidance.style: Dark background `#131722`, stroke `#089981` for upward trends, stroke `#F23645` for downward trends, linear gradient area fills with 0.2 opacity.
chart_integration_guidance.tooltip: Custom dark tooltip with `bg-[#1E222D] border border-[#2A2E39] text-xs font-mono shadow-xl`.
